title: What Would Happen on Mars Without a Suit
topic: Hand-drawn style prototype: low pressure, CO2 air and cold on Mars (M3.2 test clip, planning narration only)

beats.narration: Step onto Mars without a spacesuit, and you'd stay awake for about fifteen seconds.
phrases: Step onto Mars without a spacesuit,
and you'd stay awake for about fifteen seconds.

beats.narration: The air is mostly carbon dioxide, and over a hundred times thinner than Earth's.
phrases: The air is mostly carbon dioxide,
and over a hundred times thinner than Earth's.

beats.narration: With so little pressure, the saliva on your tongue starts to boil.
phrases: the saliva on your tongue starts to boil.

beats.narration: And an average day is minus sixty degrees Celsius.
Then you pass out. So on Mars, the suit stays on.
phrases: So on Mars, the suit stays on.
